items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: What band was that in Alexandria you worked with? Jones Thompson. Yeah, yeah, yeah, man. I remember him.

ctx.x: Who did he play with? I didn't know the band he used to play up the road, you know. Oh, right. But when he come back here, he said he'd play different. He played with Celestine a little while, but he didn't make out, because he went back to Chicago. Just like when I went with this band, Alexander, he said it was like four years, and they come back, they played different from here, you know. I had to learn all over again to play the style, yeah. That's right. Up in Alexandria, they played like a circus band. Fast,…
